title: 12 Best Date Night Restaurants in Tokyo
description: Discover Tokyo's most romantic and exciting date night restaurants for 2026. From Michelin-starred kaiseki to vibrant izakayas and stunning skyline views, find your perfect spot.

places.name: L'Osier
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The seasonal tasting menu, particularly dishes featuring seafood like the Brittany Lobster or their signature pâté en croûte.

places.name: Ishikawa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The chef's omakase menu, which changes seasonally but always features pristine ingredients and elegant presentation.

places.name: Sushi no Midori (Ginza)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Cho Tokusen Nigiri Set' (Special Premium Nigiri Set) for a generous and delicious selection of seasonal fish.

places.name: New York Bar (Park Hyatt Tokyo)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic cocktail like a Manhattan or a Japanese whisky, paired with their Wagyu beef slider or cheese plate.

places.name: Tempura Kondo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Omakase Tempura course, allowing the chef to guide you through a procession of perfectly fried seasonal vegetables and seafood.

places.name: Gonpachi Nishi-Azabu
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A selection of yakitori skewers (chicken, vegetables), their handmade soba noodles, and classic sashimi.

places.name: Ginza Kojyu
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The seasonal omakase tasting menu, which highlights premium ingredients like Matsusaka beef, Hokkaido crab, or unique seasonal vegetables.

places.name: Peter (The Peninsula Tokyo)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their premium Japanese Wagyu steaks or succulent seafood, paired with a selection from their extensive wine list.

places.name: Afuri (Ebisu)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Yuzu Shio Ramen, with a side of their delicious gyoza or a grilled char siu rice bowl.

places.name: Tapas Molecular Bar (Mandarin Oriental Tokyo)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order There's only one option: the chef's carefully curated tasting menu, which changes seasonally and is a surprise with every dish.

places.name: Teppanyaki Ginza Honten
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A course menu featuring Japanese Wagyu beef, alongside seasonal seafood and grilled vegetables.

places.name: Pizzeria e Trattoria da ISA
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The classic Margherita or the 'Stella' (star-shaped pizza with ricotta-filled crust points), paired with a glass of Italian wine.
